description: Defines the enum AccountTransferType representing different types of account transfer operations within the Fineract project, including methods for conversion and type checks.

classes.name: AccountTransferType
classes.description: Enum representing various account transfer types such as invalid, account transfer, loan repayment, charge payment, interest transfer, and loan down payment.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer value to the corresponding AccountTransferType enum.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current enum instance has the same state as the provided AccountTransferType.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum instance.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the enum instance.

methods.name: isAccountTransfer
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents an account transfer.

methods.name: isLoanRepayment
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents a loan repayment.

methods.name: isChargePayment
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents a charge payment.

methods.name: isInterestTransfer
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents an interest transfer.

methods.name: isLoanDownPayment
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance represents a loan down payment.
